item.title: Subscribe the Printed Version: Acta Medica Indonesiana
item.description: If you want to subscribe the printed version of Acta Medica Indonesiana (The Indonesian Journal of Internal Medicine), please send to us the following information:1. Name2. Address (street, city, country, postal code)3. Phone/mobile phone4. email5. Subscription period (in years)The information above should be emailed to pipfkui@yahoo.com, and we will contact you soon. Thank you!
